chunks: And with this chain, Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) narrated from his father (peace be upon him) who said: Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them) was asked: Why was the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) deprived of both his father and mother?
He said: So that a right due to a created being would not be obligatory upon him.
ai.seo_question: Why was Prophet Muhammad an orphan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights a key theological point in Shia scholarship: the Prophet’s orphanhood was a divine decree to ensure his spiritual and social independence, free from the obligations of kinship or patronage that might compromise his prophetic authority. By losing both parents, he remained solely accountable to God, reinforcing the concept of *Ismah* (infallibility) and pure divine selection without worldly entanglements.
